raw.query: WITH belief AS (SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS nondegenerate_ticks, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY engine_rps) AS median_engine_rps FROM provenance.capacity_belief_sample WHERE run_id = 'riders:fc_lead60' AND NOT is_degenerate GROUP BY run_id), probes AS (SELECT k.probe_id, k.window_name, k.probe_kind, k.arrival_speedup, k.forecast_req_scale, k.offered_rps_per_replica, k.implied_r_tail, k.p99_ttft_ms, k.p99_itl_ms, k.sla_ttft_p99_ms, k.sla_itl_p99_ms, k.passes, k.is_superseded, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.tp, d.n_replicas, p.n_requests FROM provenance.capacity_knee_probe k JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = k.run_id AND d.window_name = k.window_name JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = k.run_id AND p.window_name = k.window_name AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft' WHERE d.is_current AND NOT k.is_superseded) SELECT b.nondegenerate_ticks, b.median_engine_rps, p.window_name, p.probe_id, p.probe_kind, p.arrival_speedup, p.forecast_req_scale, p.offered_rps_per_replica, p.implied_r_tail, p.p99_ttft_ms, p.p99_itl_ms, p.sla_ttft_p99_ms, p.sla_itl_p99_ms, p.passes, p.is_current, p.is_superseded, p.superseded_by, p.tp, p.n_replicas, p.n_requests FROM belief b CROSS JOIN probes p ORDER BY p.window_name, p.probe_kind, COALESCE(p.arrival_speedup, p.forecast_req_scale)
raw.observed: The median is 10.07 over 86 nondegenerate ticks. For burst1, the largest tested passing offered rate is 1.6233047244281011 req/s per replica, while 2.1643370639993678 fails. Burst4 has no offered-rate probes: forecast-scale probes pass at implied capacities 1.25875 and 1.4385714285714286 and fail at 1.6189710610932477.
raw.claimed: r_hat=10.07 req/s (median); measured tail knee r_tail=1.62 req/s on burst1 and [1.26, 1.44] req/s on burst4, defined as the largest offered rate sustained under the tail SLA.
raw.evidence: All selected rows are current and nonsuperseded; the belief and burst1 value are supported, but burst4's values are implied forecast-scale capacities, not a measured offered-rate knee or knee bracket.
raw.fix: Retain the 10.07 median and describe burst1 as the largest tested passing offered rate; replace the burst4 knee claim with: forecast-scale probes passed at implied capacities 1.25875 and 1.4385714285714286 req/s and failed at 1.6189710610932477 req/s, so no direct burst4 offered-rate knee was measured.
